summary: A grown daughter hears her father sweep a whole group into one hated word and asks whether that includes her.
realLife: A graduate student says talk about politics with her family usually turns bad fast. She says her father says he hates all the liberals, and she asks whether that includes her; he says no, and she thinks he might. She blames big stories and labels and wants people to trade them for smaller personal stories.
sources: https://www.kcur.org/politics-elections-and-government/2019-09-09/storycorps-in-kansas-city-getting-past-political-narratives-to-find-the-smaller-stories (KCUR StoryCorps pairing of two strangers; she describes her father)
